basic_details.job_title: IHM Bhopal Principal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Institute of Hotel Management, Catering Technology & Applied Nutrition, Bhopal (IHM Bhopal), Madhya Pradesh, has invited applications for the post of Principal. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 20 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand draft favouring 'Secretary, Institute of Hotel Management, Bhopal'.

age_limit.age_details: Not exceeding 53 years for general category (as on 4 December 2026)

qualification.education_qualification: Category A: Post-Graduation plus full time degree/three years diploma in hotel administration or related field with minimum 55%, and 20 years' experience. Category B: two year full time PG degree/diploma in Management/Tourism with minimum 60% and 20 years' experience. Category C (deputation/short term contract): two year full time PG/Master degree/PG diploma in Management/Tourism. Desirable: Ph.D.
qualification.details: Qualification: Category A: Post-Graduation from a recognized University, and full time degree/full time three years diploma in Hotel Administration / Hospitality Management / Hotel Management / Hospitality Administration / Culinary Arts / Culinary Science with minimum 55% marks in aggregate or equivalent grade; Category B: Two year full time Post Graduate Degree / Post Graduate Diploma in Management/Tourism with minimum 60% marks in aggregate or equivalent grade; Category C (deputation / short term contract): Two year full time Post Graduate Degree / Master Degree / Post Graduate Diploma in Management/Tourism from a recognized University; Desirable: Ph.D. Degree Experience: At least 20 years of experience under Category A or B, as printed; Category C requires leadership role in pay level 13 or equivalent, or minimum 5 years in pay level 12 or equivalent Age limit: Not exceeding 53 years for general category (as on 4 December 2026) Age relaxation: Other categories As per government norms, Employees of autonomous bodies under the Ministry of Tourism Up to 5 years | Other conditions: | Advance copy with all enclosures must be sent directly to the Institute by the closing date if forwarding is delayed | Desirable: | Ph.D. Degree

salary_details.pay_scale: Level 13 in Pay Matrix (as per 7th CPC), equivalent to Group A

how_to_apply: Download the application form in the prescribed format from www.ihmbhopal.ac.in.
Fill in the form and enclose attested copies of testimonials.
Attach a demand draft of Rs. 1000/- favouring 'Secretary, Institute of Hotel Management, Bhopal'.
Write 'Application for the post of Principal.' on the envelope.
Send by speed post to the Principal at the Institute's Bhopal address so that it reaches within 30 days of the date of publication of the advertisement.
Applications sent by email will not be entertained.
Make sure it reaches by 20 December 2026.
important_instructions: Competent Authority may reject or accept any application and fill or not fill the vacancy or re-advertise the post without giving any reason

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Category A: Post-Graduation from a recognized University, and full time degree/full time three years diploma in Hotel Administration / Hospitality Management / Hotel Management / Hospitality Administration / Culinary Arts / Culinary Science with minimum 55% marks in aggregate or equivalent grade; Category B: Two year full time Post Graduate Degree / Post Graduate Diploma in Management/Tourism with minimum 60% marks in aggregate or equivalent grade; Category C (deputation / short term contract): Two year full time Post Graduate Degree / Master Degree / Post Graduate Diploma in Management/Tourism from a recognized University; Desirable: Ph.D. Degree Experience: At least 20 years of experience under Category A or B, as printed; Category C requires leadership role in pay level 13 or equivalent, or minimum 5 years in pay level 12 or equivalent Age limit: Not exceeding 53 years for general category (as on 4 December 2026) Age relaxation: Other categories As per government norms, Employees of autonomous bodies under the Ministry of Tourism Up to 5 years Other conditions: Advance copy with all enclosures must be sent directly to the Institute by the closing date if forwarding is delayed Desirable: Ph.D. Degree

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IHM Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IHM Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Principal.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IHM Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Institute website www.ihmbhopal.ac.in) and send it to PRINCIPAL, INSTITUTE OF HOTEL MANAGEMENT, CATERING TECHNOLOGY AND APPLIED NUTRITION, BHOPAL, NEAR ACADEMY OF ADMINISTRATION, 1100 QUARTERS, BHOPAL-462016 MADHYA PRADESH, by speed post, to reach by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: Rs. 1000 (non-refundable in any circumstances).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 53 years for general category (as on 4 December 2026). Relaxation: Other categories As per government norms, Employees of autonomous bodies under the Ministry of Tourism Up to 5 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level 13 in Pay Matrix (as per 7th CPC), equivalent to Group A.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Category A: Post-Graduation plus full time degree/three years diploma in hotel administration or related field with minimum 55%, and 20 years' experience. Category B: two year full time PG degree/diploma in Management/Tourism with minimum 60% and 20 years' experience. Category C (deputation/short term contract): two year full time PG/Master degree/PG diploma in Management/Tourism. Desirable: Ph.D.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Advance copy with all enclosures must be sent directly to the Institute by the closing date if forwarding is delayed.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications. Applications received after due date.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates called for interview.
